sections.title: Pieces of Heart
sections.note: Twelve pieces, every four make a heart. Tags give what you need.

items.name: Behind the small tree south of Mayor Ruul's house
items.area: One screen south of Mayor Ruul's house
items.howTo: Hop down the ledge south of Mayor Ruul's house, go up the steps and burn the small tree with an Ember Seed to reach the Piece of Heart behind it.

items.name: Cave reached over the winter snow
items.area: Cave north of the stump two screens east of Horon Village
items.howTo: Leave Horon Village by the east exit and go one more screen east to the stump. Change the season to winter, go up one screen and then left across the snow, and enter the cave. The Piece of Heart is inside.
items.notes: StrategyWiki places this cave in the East Suburbs; Zelda Dungeon calls the area Woods of Winter.

items.name: Under a rock by the Woods of Winter pond
items.area: The pond in the Woods of Winter
items.howTo: Find the pond in the Woods of Winter and lift the rock beside it with the Power Bracelet to take the Piece of Heart.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon says you can also swim to it, and gives the route: from the stump one screen east of the Woods of Winter entrance, set winter, then go left one, up one, right one, up three, right two, down one and right two.

items.name: Rare Peach Stone at the Subrosia Market
items.howTo: Trade for the 'Rare Peach Stone' (an upside-down Piece of Heart) at the Subrosia Market: 20 Ore Chunks and 10 Ember Seeds. Dig up Ore Chunks in the clearing just right of the market.
items.notes: Zelda Wiki (quoting the shopkeeper) and Zelda Dungeon say 20 Ore Chunks; StrategyWiki says 10.

items.name: Dropped by Maple
items.howTo: Defeat 30 enemies (15 with Maple's Ring on) and Maple flies in at the next screen change. Bump into her and she sometimes drops the Piece of Heart, which is random. She goes for it first, so grab it fast: Pegasus Seeds help.
items.notes: It can take many meetings. Maple doesn't appear in dungeons or Subrosia.

items.name: Carried by the spring current in Spool Swamp
items.area: River south of Poison Moth's Lair
items.howTo: Go to the stump one screen south of Poison Moth's Lair and change the season to spring. Follow the river south (Zelda Dungeon: right, down three, right two, down one) and let the current carry you left to the Piece of Heart.

items.name: Chest in the ruins of Moblin's Keep
items.area: Moblin's Keep, west of Sunken City
items.howTo: Reach the Moblin's Keep (StrategyWiki: its western entrance, with your animal friend), climb the stairs and beat the Great Moblin by throwing his bombs back. The keep collapses, and a chest in the rubble holds the Piece of Heart.
items.notes: Zelda Wiki: the keep is west of Sunken City, reached from the bottom left through Natzu. StrategyWiki lists the animal friend's flute as the requirement, Zelda Dungeon the Power Bracelet.

items.name: Ledge below the Dancing Dragon Dungeon
items.howTo: From the Dancing Dragon Dungeon entrance, jump down through the gap in the southern wall and pick up the Piece of Heart. StrategyWiki's route there: in spring, ride a Spring Flower up to the upper ledge, head east a few screens and drop down by the stump.

items.name: Inside a Gasha Nut
items.howTo: One Gasha Nut per game holds a Piece of Heart. It can only come from the four best spots: Goron Mountain, Eyeglass Lake by Unicorn's Cave, Mt. Cucco in autumn and Tarm Ruins. Plant Gasha Seeds there and keep harvesting until it turns up.
items.notes: TourianTourist: the Piece of Heart needs a spot that reaches class 4 or 5. Goron Mountain and Tarm Ruins (class 3–5) are the best bets; the Gasha Ring makes nuts grow twice as fast. See the Gasha tracker.

items.name: Cave in the dried-up Eyeglass Lake
items.howTo: From the stump above Eyeglass Lake change the season to summer, then go right one and down two screens. Walk down the steps into the dried-up lake, go up one screen, lift the rock and go down the stairs. Fight through the three-room cave to the chest with the Piece of Heart.
items.notes: StrategyWiki also lists the Zora's Flippers to swim a short stretch.

items.name: Behind the Rock Mushrooms by the Explorer's Crypt
items.area: One screen right of the Explorer's Crypt entrance
items.howTo: After the Piratians dock on the Western Coast, change the season to autumn at the stump there. Go back through the house and along the path to the Graveyard, through the cave where you jump a gap with the Roc's Cape. At the Explorer's Crypt entrance pick up the Rock Mushrooms, head right a screen and take the Piece of Heart.
items.notes: StrategyWiki: after clearing the seventh dungeon.

items.name: Cave in the Temple Remains
items.area: Cracked wall in the north of the Temple Remains
items.howTo: After the Subrosian volcanoes erupt, bomb the cracked wall in the northern part of the Temple Remains. Inside, cross the room with the Roc's Cape to the Piece of Heart at the back.

sections.title: Heart Containers
sections.note: One from each of the eight bosses, plus one from a linked-game secret.

items.name: Aquamentus
items.howTo: Defeat Aquamentus at the end of Gnarled Root Dungeon and take the Heart Container it leaves.

items.name: Dodongo
items.howTo: Defeat Dodongo at the end of Snake's Remains and take the Heart Container it leaves.

items.name: Mothula
items.howTo: Defeat Mothula at the end of Poison Moth's Lair and take the Heart Container it leaves.

items.name: Gohma
items.howTo: Defeat Gohma at the end of Dancing Dragon Dungeon and take the Heart Container it leaves.

items.name: Digdogger
items.howTo: Defeat Digdogger at the end of Unicorn's Cave and take the Heart Container it leaves.

items.name: Manhandla

items.name: Gleeok

items.name: Heart Container from a linked secret
items.area: The grave with no flowers (or Farore in the Hall of Secrets)
items.howTo: Seasons played first: in the linked Ages, after Spirit's Grave, a Ghini outside Syrup's shop in Yoll Graveyard tells you the Graveyard Secret. Here, dig behind the tombstone second from the left in the first row (the only grave with no flowers) and tell it to the green Ghini inside. Answer whether more red or blue Ghini appeared, three times in a row. Seasons played second: get the Fairy Secret from the woman by the Horon Village fountain, tell it to the blue fairy in Ages' Fairies' Woods, and tell the return secret to Farore.
items.notes: Only one of the two routes applies to a given file. A linked game also starts you with 4 hearts instead of 3, which the total above doesn't count.
